finalists.oldTeaching: Keep outlet width against deep 1:5 pressure (decorative system)
finalists.newTeaching: Against 5+1, refuse the baited left-wide action into the advanced pair; keep safe structure
finalists.whyEarnsGold: The advanced pair creates a trap that does not exist in flat 6:0, so the system is causally required. The decision is inhibitory and realistic for wings who love the wide finish. It fills an unused approved system family with no RW twin. A/B hinges on whether the trap is still on the left channel. Curriculum gains a true sparse-system attack lesson after 1:5 failed.

finalists.oldTeaching: Stop forcing second wave when advantage gone (RW 877 twin)
finalists.newTeaching: Enter toward six only after WD overcommit empties a real lane that LB can still deliver into
finalists.whyEarnsGold: This is the positive pair to locked 967 (when not to enter), not another stop-forcing transition twin. Two live cues — emptied path and LB deliverability — create a clear A/B. Related RW enter-after-help families do not use the same delivery co-cue. It replaces a failed second-wave stop with a missing entry decision in the Gold set.

finalists.oldTeaching: Empty own goal dirty catch → safe return (RW 879 twin)
finalists.newTeaching: In 5:1 defence, do not make a 6:0 help chase into the channel the advanced defender already owns — hold the wing
finalists.whyEarnsGold: Empty-own attack risk is dead; this slot becomes defence and improves the 27/7 attack skew. The 5:1 advanced defender causally changes the wing job versus 6:0. No RW defence twin owns this fork. Difficulty is Advanced from habit override, not from empty-goal drama.

finalists.oldTeaching: After RB binds you then looks wing, keep pass + call half (962 twin)
finalists.newTeaching: Release the wing runner only after handover is real — half contact plus ownership call
finalists.whyEarnsGold: The decision is ownership release timing, not close-the-pass when half is stuck (962). RW 880 mixes protect-pass with controlled help; this isolates the release trigger. Live contact + call justify perception. It repairs the failed cooperation slot with a genuine two-defender responsibility change.
